devdoc.details: Stores and manages all campaign data. Does NOT hold ETH.      Only the StartupFund contract (set as authorized) can write state.

checkStatus(uint256).details: Evaluates and updates the campaign status.      - Goal reached at any time → FUNDED      - Deadline passed + goal not met → CANCELLED      Called by StartupFund after every contribution, withdraw, and refund.      Implements ICampaign.checkStatus().

createCampaign(string,string,string,stri.details: Creates a new campaign. Called by StartupFund.createCampaign().      Function signature must exactly match StartupFund ABI.

getCampaign(uint256).details: Required by ICampaign — returns core campaign fields.

getCampaignDescription(uint256).details: Returns the full description. Called by useCampaigns.ts.

getCampaignMeta(uint256).details: Returns metadata fields. Called by useCampaigns.ts.

getCampaignStats(uint256).details: Returns numeric/status fields. Called by useCampaigns.ts.

getStatus(uint256).details: Returns the status as uint8. Called by useCampaigns.ts.

setAuthorized(address).details: Called once after StartupFund is deployed.

updateRaisedAmount(uint256,uint256,bool).details: Updates the raised amount and backer count. Called by StartupFund.fundCampaign().
